description: "PlayerControlpp"是一款Minecraft Java版模组。该模组依赖"malilib"、"Fabric API"和"mod menu"。该模组提供了一些自动化功能，例如自动前进，快速转身等。

mods.name: PlayerControlpp
mods.description: A lightweight client-side mod that enhances player controls with auto-forward, quick-turn, route flow, input recording and Litematica/Baritone automation.
